summary: A 1961 CL-100 cab on a 30-ft steel tower, after a 1915 Forest Service lookout; manned in 2004, with road access reports that disagree.

corrections.why: The register gives the 1961 steel tower as 30 feet (9.1 m). The 60-foot figure (18.3 m) is from 1915 papers about the earlier first tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1961 tower is 30 feet per the register. Several 1915 papers give 50 feet and one gives 60 feet for the earlier tower, so that earlier height stays uncertain.
A 2004 register visit note says two-wheel drive can make the trip; a later road guide says four-wheel drive only. Treat the access as uncertain and check the Forest.

notes_for_editor: Confirmed: the 1961 build year and the January 3, 2015 registration. The brief's 18.3 m height matches the 1915 first tower (60 ft), not the 1961 cab (30 ft per the register), so the correction is proposed. Staffing rests on a 2004 visit note and an undated road guide, and no recent staffing source was found. A Facebook post from the Forest Fire Lookout Association (search snippet only, not read) calls the first tower 60 feet, and it is not cited. The 1915 papers quoted on the weebly page are reprinted newspaper extracts, not checked against the original papers.
